subject: SOC2 packet - any blockers for review?

Cc: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Apr 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: SOC2 packet + next steps

Hi Alice — great talking earlier. Quick recap and next steps from today

- Summary: We covered deployment modes (hosted vs dedicated) and data isolation options for your regulated workflows. You mentioned a SOC2 review timeline around mid-April.
- Action: Attached is our SOC2 packet (controls mapping, auditor report excerpts, and data handling overview).
- Next steps: If your security team has questions, Mateo can join a short walk-through (20-30 min) to go through any technical details.

Attachments: Redwood_SOC2_Packet_v1.pdf (PDF, 2.4 MB)

If it helps, suggested availability for a quick call next week: Tue/Wed mornings PST.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Hi Alice — circling back again. We haven't heard from your security team and I wanted to check if there are any specific blockers that we can help clear. Options we can offer quickly:

- 20-min technical walkthrough with Mateo to go over controls and evidence mapping
- Escalation to our security lead for a brief Q&A if auditors are requesting clarifications
- Provide a condensed one-page controls summary tailored to the specific items you flagged (if that helps speed review)

If priority changed, let me know and we can adjust. Otherwise, if I don't hear back I can follow up with a proposed time to connect later this week.

From: Alice Johnson <alice.johnson@fintechco.com>

Cc: FinTechCo Security <security@fintechco.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Follow-up: SOC2 packet + next steps

Hi Marissa — apologies for the delay. Security has the packet and has started an initial pass this week. A couple quick items they asked me to confirm:

1) Retention windows: can you confirm default request/usage log retention and whether customers can set a custom retention policy?
2) Request-level metadata: does your hosted API include full request headers in audit logs (we need IP + request id for correlation)?

We expect a fuller list of questions by EOD next Tuesday (28 Apr). If Mateo can join a short call to answer these two quick items now, that would speed things up.

Thanks,
Alice Johnson
Director, Platform Security | FinTechCo
alice.johnson@fintechco.com
